label: Codex local Memory runtime
definition: The local cross-thread Memory generation, consolidation, file-backed retrieval and lifecycle path implemented by openai/codex.
inclusion: Thread eligibility, Phase 1/2, Memory DB, file artifacts, read tools, citations, scope, reset and adjacent state boundaries.
exclusion: Model weights, training, complete hosted cloud backend, generic context compaction and unrelated RAM usage.
problem: How Codex turns prior coding-agent work into reusable local state without treating every transcript or project rule as the same kind of memory.
tradeoffs: inspectable files versus model-mediated semantic correctness
cross-project reuse versus hard scope isolation
cheap lexical read versus dependence on generated keywords
background automation versus quota and recovery complexity
